items.title: Park Map — lots track the base map while panning, no cut-off edges
items.precondition: Signed in (any demo account), Park Map open, zoom at lot level
steps: 1. Drag the map a few hundred pixels in any direction
2. Watch the lot layer during and right after the drag
items.expected: Lots ride the ground with the tiles; regions that were off-screen paint in; no blank canvas edge, no stale offset after release
items.evidence: Agent run 2026-07-31: drag (750,450)→(520,560) — lot clusters moved with the ground, previously off-screen cluster fully painted, no cut-offs (screenshot pair in session)
items.notes: Canvas is now pane-anchored (div-pixel space) and oversized by 200px per side

items.title: Park Map — zoom re-projects lots immediately, no stale-size overlay
steps: 1. Zoom in two steps (buttons or wheel)
2. Look at the lot layer right after the zoom settles
items.expected: Lots are crisply re-projected at the new scale with status badges; no old-scale bitmap lingering
items.evidence: Agent run 2026-07-31: two zoom-ins — lots re-projected with badges, aligned to the field on satellite tiles

items.title: Park Map — site plan image stays pinned to its ground bounds
items.precondition: Park Map open, 'Show site plan' toggled on
steps: 1. Enable Show site plan
2. Pan and zoom
3. Watch the plan image against the tiles
items.expected: The plan renders under the lots, pinned to its bounds at all times; no size lag on zoom, no repositioning snap
items.evidence: Agent run 2026-07-31: overlay on at 55% — plan aligned with ground (chapel circle over white-roof building, BLOCK 02 frame around B02 lots); rendered in overlayLayer pane under the lot canvas
items.notes: Overlay is now an OverlayView in a map pane, positioned in draw() — same mechanism as Google's GroundOverlay

items.title: Map Editor — first paint shows lots inside their blocks (no frozen misplaced layer)
items.precondition: Signed in as Judith C. Montero (Administrator), Map Editor open
steps: 1. Open Map Editor
2. Compare lots, block outlines, and site plan
items.expected: Lots render inside their block outlines, over the site plan — not as a detached blob in a corner
items.evidence: Agent run 2026-07-31: B01/B02/B03 lots inside their outlines over the ghost plan; the pre-fix frozen bottom-right blob is gone
items.notes: Was the clearest symptom of the container-pixel/pane mismatch

items.title: Map Editor — all layers move together on camera and geometry changes
steps: 1. Click 'Reset north and fit layout'
2. In Align mode, nudge the layout with an arrow key, then undo
items.expected: Lots, block outlines, labels, and site plan move as one unit in both cases; no layer lags or stays behind
items.evidence: Agent run 2026-07-31: fit re-anchored all layers together; 6 arrow-key nudges moved lot canvas + chrome coherently (then undone — draft left clean)

items.title: Both pages read the same dataset (904 lots, same status counts)
steps: 1. Park Map: read legend counts
2. Map Editor: read the Lots step count
items.expected: Park Map legend totals 904 (684/18/156/40/6) and Map Editor shows Lots 904 — identical inventory from the shared dataset
items.evidence: Agent run 2026-07-31: verified in both pages, two different roles (Owner, Administrator)

items.title: Clean editor draft refreshes after a dataset mutation elsewhere
items.precondition: Editor draft has no staged changes (clean)
steps: 1. Open Map Editor, make no edits, leave
2. Record a payment or sale so lot status changes
3. Return to Map Editor
items.expected: The draft re-hydrates: the changed lot shows its new status in the editor without a page reload
items.notes: Store logic implemented (dataset version tracking); needs a mutation flow to observe end-to-end. Dirty drafts intentionally keep priority.

items.title: Wheel-zoom animation — overlays track the zoom with real input
items.precondition: Real mouse/trackpad (synthetic wheel events do not dispatch in the embedded QA pane)
steps: 1. Wheel-zoom in and out rapidly on Park Map and Map Editor
2. Watch lots/site plan against the tiles during the animation
items.expected: Overlays scale with the tiles during the animation (may soften briefly), then repaint crisp — no old-size freeze, no jump
items.notes: Pane transforms carry the bitmap during the animation by construction; needs a human wheel to confirm feel

items.title: Cluster chips at low zoom ride the map while dragging
items.precondition: Park Map zoomed out below lot-visible zoom (18)
steps: 1. Zoom out until block cluster chips replace lots
2. Drag the map
items.expected: Chips stay glued to their blocks during the drag (no drift until drag-end)
items.notes: Chips now position via div-pixel space in draw() — same fix class as the verified layers; embedded pane could not reach low zoom synthetically

items.title: Lot hover tooltip and click-select still work
steps: 1. Hover a lot — tooltip with code/tier/status appears near the cursor
2. Click a lot — map flies to it and the drawer opens
items.expected: Tooltip lands at the cursor; click selects the right lot
items.notes: Hit-testing shares coordinate space with drawing by construction; embedded pane throttles the rAF hover path while hidden, so needs a human hover

items.title: Editor 'Default' base shows the standard street map (Rev 1)
steps: 1. In BASE MAP, click 'Default'
2. Look at the base map
items.expected: Roads, building footprints, and place labels render; Park Map's 'Plain' stays parchment
items.evidence: Agent run 2026-07-31: roadmap rendered with streets, buildings, 'Lupon Sport Oval Ground' and school labels under the layout
items.notes: BaseLayer 'plain' flavour: parchment (Park Map) vs roadmap (editor)

items.title: Block outlines wrap their lots; editor review clean (Rev 2)
steps: 1. Open Map Editor
2. Compare each block outline against its lot grid
3. Check the Review step
items.expected: Outlines hug their grids (2 m verge); Review shows no issues; header says 'Nothing to publish'
items.evidence: Agent run 2026-07-31: rotated-frame centre fix removed the ~8.6 m drift; the previous 206 review issues dropped to zero ('ready')

items.title: Seeded layout centres on the oval ground (Rev 2)
steps: 1. Open Park Map or Map Editor at the fit view
2. Compare the layout against the oval field in the imagery
items.expected: The three blocks straddle the oval field ('Lupon Sport Oval Ground'), not hanging off to its east
items.evidence: Agent run 2026-07-31: satellite view shows lots over the field; roadmap labels the same area 'Lupon Sport Oval Ground'; fit-view centre latitude matched the computed target (6.898322) exactly
items.notes: Fine-tuning by a few metres, if wanted, is a one-arrow-key job in the editor's Align mode
